e_definition: Company-defined Adjusted EBITDA (non-IFRS) as printed in that year's year-end MD&A, US$ million. Each year uses the contemporaneous print (not later restatements). Perimeter is consolidated / All Operations — the headline the company used each year. 2025 also discloses continuing $889.3m and discontinued $450.2m; primary E is All Operations $1,339.6m. YE EV = (basic shares outstanding at 31 Dec × NYSE American last-session close in USD) + company-labelled net debt (loans and borrowings current+non-current − unrestricted cash). Convertibles included at carrying amount in loans. No vendor EV or vendor EBITDA.
